parsed.why: Worst of the five: standing criminal drag ban upheld, birth-sex facility and shelter mandates, 2019 indecent-exposure statute, no marker change since 1977, panic defence live, killings above national homicide rate.

Universal birth-sex facility restriction in state-run facilities, surgical birth-certificate closure, no GI hate-crime or discrimination statute, ranked among worst legislating states; but no documented violence incidents and 78% public support for nondiscrimination.

No facility or expression criminalisation documented; care bans and surgery cancellation are mainly resident-facing. Police themselves call violence 'epidemic-level,' a real hostility signal, but no criminalisation of visitor presentation and no state targeting.

Operating protections: public-accommodations coverage reaching lodging and services with a working civil-rights complaint body, GI hate-crime enhancements, panic-defence ban, most-protective tier ranking. Held below higher by the shared national border/document regime.

Thin record: nationally imposed bathroom ban in the seat, activists arrested enforcing it, national legislature can override local law. No local protections or hostility documented; extrapolates slightly below the national average from the facility exposure.
